notablePrerequisites: You have at least two opponents.
description:
Activate Faerie Mastermind by paying {1}{U}, causing you to draw a card and create a Treasure artifact token for each opponent you have.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
If you have three or more opponents, this combo nets near-infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.
